# Autonomous Agent Instructions (H6：让笑话真的发生)

Read [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md), [`BACKLOG.md`](../BACKLOG.md) and [`docs/design/H6-comedy-consequence-guide.md`](../docs/design/H6-comedy-consequence-guide.md) first. Execute H6-1 → H6-7 in order, one commit per task. Comedy templates must create real, rule-settled consequences (recruits, items, building damage, relations, recurring visits, sequels) and report text must state those concrete facts; away jobs resolve within the month; no disclaimer-style copy. Verify with `npm run verify`, update BACKLOG and CHANGELOG, commit and push to `origin main`, then continue immediately.
